decision.reasoning_trace: I filtered through the product feed to identify actual backpacks, as several items were unrelated accessories like towels, fire starters, and umbrellas. My consideration set included a variety of specialized and general-purpose backpacks: a high-capacity tactical bag, two hiking daypacks, a sports-themed bag, and a specialized fishing tackle backpack. I ultimately chose the QT&QY 45L Military Tactical Backpack (prod_backpacks_057) because it offers an excellent balance of capacity and durability at a competitive price point ($39.99). Its rating of 4.7 across over 6,000 reviews provides significant confidence in its quality compared to other options like the SHENHU or the KAILAS hiking bags.
